title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of the Company Law of the People's Republic of China (III)

articles.content_en: Article 1 For the purposes of these Provisions, a person who signs the articles of association for the establishment of a company, subscribes to capital contributions or shares in the company, and performs the duties of company establishment shall be identified as a promoter of the company, including shareholders at the time of the establishment of a limited liability company.

Article 2 Where a promoter, for the purpose of establishing a company, enters into a contract with a third party in its own name, and the counterparty to the contract requests the promoter to bear the contractual liability, the People's Court shall uphold such request; after the company is established, if the counterparty to the contract requests the company to bear the contractual liability, the People's Court shall uphold such request.

Article 3 Where a promoter, in the name of a company being established, enters into a contract with a third party, and after the company is established, the counterparty to the contract requests the company to bear the contractual liability, the People's Court shall uphold such request.
After the company is established, if there is evidence proving that the promoter, in the name of the company being established, entered into a contract with the counterparty for its own benefit, and the company claims that it shall not bear the contractual liability on this ground, the People's Court shall uphold such claim, unless the counterparty is in good faith.

Article 4 Where the company is not established for any reason, and a creditor requests all or some of the promoters to bear joint and several liability for discharging the expenses and debts incurred by the act of establishment, the People's Court shall uphold such request.
Where some promoters, after assuming liability in accordance with the preceding paragraph, request other promoters to share such liability, the People's Court shall order the other promoters to share the liability in proportion to the agreed liability-sharing ratio; if no such ratio is agreed, they shall share the liability in proportion to the agreed capital contribution ratio; if no capital contribution ratio is agreed, they shall share the liability in equal shares.
Where the company is not established due to the fault of some promoters, and other promoters claim that such promoters shall bear the expenses and debts incurred by the act of establishment, the People's Court shall determine the scope of liability of the faulty party based on the circumstances of the fault.

Article 5 Where a promoter causes harm to another person in performing the duties of company establishment, and after the company is established the victim requests the company to bear tort compensation liability, the People's Court shall uphold such request; if the company is not established, and the victim requests all promoters to bear joint and several compensation liability, the People's Court shall uphold such request.
After the company or a promoter without fault assumes compensation liability, it may seek recourse against the promoter at fault.

Article 6 Where a subscriber of a joint stock limited company fails to pay the share subscription money on time, and after being urged by the company's promoters, still fails to pay within a reasonable period, and the promoters raise the shares anew, the People's Court shall find such new raising valid. If the subscriber's delayed payment of share subscription money causes loss to the company, and the company requests the subscriber to bear compensation liability, the People's Court shall uphold such request.

Article 7 Where a capital contributor makes capital contributions with property over which it does not have the right of disposition, and the parties dispute the validity of the capital contribution, the People's Court may make a determination by reference to the provisions of Article 311 of the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China.
Where equity is obtained by making capital contributions with monetary funds derived from illegal or criminal activities such as embezzlement, bribery, misappropriation, or unlawful use, when such illegal or criminal activities are investigated and punished, the equity shall be disposed of by auction or sale.

Article 8 Where a capital contributor makes capital contributions with the right to use allocated land, or with the right to use land on which a right burden is imposed, and the company, other shareholders, or creditors of the company claim that the capital contributor has not performed the capital contribution obligation, the People's Court shall order the parties to complete the procedures for land modification or release the right burden within a specified reasonable period; if such procedures are not completed or the burden is not released within the time limit, the People's Court shall find that the capital contributor has not fully performed the capital contribution obligation according to law.

Article 9 Where a capital contributor makes capital contributions with non-monetary property without assessing its value according to law, and the company, other shareholders, or creditors of the company request a finding that the capital contributor has not performed the capital contribution obligation, the People's Court shall entrust a legally qualified appraisal institution to appraise the property. If the appraised value is significantly lower than the amount set forth in the articles of association, the People's Court shall find that the capital contributor has not fully performed the capital contribution obligation according to law.

Article 10 Where a capital contributor makes capital contributions with property such as a house, the right to use land, or intellectual property rights that require registration of title, and has delivered such property to the company for use but has not completed the formalities for change of title, and the company, other shareholders, or creditors of the company claim that the capital contributor has not performed the capital contribution obligation, the People's Court shall order the parties to complete the title change formalities within a specified reasonable period; if the title change formalities are completed within the aforesaid period, the People's Court shall find that the capital contributor has performed the capital contribution obligation; if the capital contributor claims to enjoy the corresponding shareholder rights from the date of actual delivery of the property to the company for use, the People's Court shall uphold such claim.
Where a capital contributor makes capital contributions with property as specified in the preceding paragraph, has completed the title change formalities but has not delivered the property to the company for use, and the company or other shareholders claim that the capital contributor shall deliver the property to the company and shall not enjoy the corresponding shareholder rights before actual delivery, the People's Court shall uphold such claim.

Article 13 Where a shareholder fails to perform or fully perform the capital contribution obligation, and the company or other shareholders request such shareholder to fully perform the capital contribution obligation to the company according to law, the People's Court shall uphold such request.
Where a creditor of the company requests a shareholder who fails to perform or fully perform the capital contribution obligation to bear supplementary compensation liability to the extent of the unpaid capital and interest for the part of the company's debts that cannot be satisfied, the People's Court shall uphold such request; if the shareholder who fails to perform or fully perform the capital contribution obligation has already assumed the above liability, and other creditors raise the same request, the People's Court shall not uphold such request.
Where a shareholder fails to perform or fully perform the capital contribution obligation at the time of company establishment, and a plaintiff who files a lawsuit under the first or second paragraph of this Article requests the company's promoters to bear joint and several liability with the defendant shareholder, the People's Court shall uphold such request; after the company's promoters assume liability, they may seek recourse against the defendant shareholder.
Where a shareholder fails to perform or fully perform the capital contribution obligation at the time of capital increase, and a plaintiff who files a lawsuit under the first or second paragraph of this Article requests the directors and senior officers who, by failing to fulfill the obligations under Article 147, paragraph 1 of the Company Law, cause the capital contribution to be unpaid, to bear corresponding liability, the People's Court shall uphold such request; after the directors and senior officers assume liability, they may seek recourse against the defendant shareholder.

Article 14 Where a shareholder withdraws its capital contribution, and the company or other shareholders request such shareholder to return the withdrawn capital and interest to the company, and other shareholders, directors, senior officers, or actual controllers who assisted in the withdrawal of capital contribution bear joint and several liability therefor, the People's Court shall uphold such request.
Where a creditor of the company requests the shareholder that withdrew capital contribution to bear supplementary compensation liability to the extent of the withdrawn capital and interest for the part of the company's debts that cannot be satisfied, and other shareholders, directors, senior officers, or actual controllers who assisted in the withdrawal of capital contribution bear joint and several liability therefor, the People's Court shall uphold such request; if the shareholder that withdrew capital contribution has already assumed the above liability, and other creditors raise the same request, the People's Court shall not uphold such request.

Article 15 Where a capital contributor makes capital contributions with non-monetary property that meets the statutory conditions, and the contributed property depreciates due to market changes or other objective factors, if the company, other shareholders, or creditors of the company request the capital contributor to bear the liability to make up the shortfall, the People's Court shall not uphold such request, unless otherwise agreed by the parties.

Article 16 Where a shareholder fails to perform or fully perform the capital contribution obligation or withdraws its capital contribution, and the company, in accordance with the articles of association or a resolution of the shareholders' meeting, imposes corresponding reasonable restrictions on such shareholder's shareholder rights, including the right to claim profit distribution, the preemptive right to subscribe for new shares, and the right to claim distribution of residual property, if the shareholder requests a finding that such restrictions are invalid, the People's Court shall not uphold such request.

Article 17 Where a shareholder of a limited liability company fails to perform the capital contribution obligation or withdraws all capital contributions, and after the company urges the shareholder to contribute or return the capital contributions, the shareholder still fails to contribute or return within a reasonable period, and the company, by a resolution of the shareholders' meeting, removes the shareholder's qualification, if the shareholder requests confirmation that such removal is invalid, the People's Court shall not uphold such request.
In the circumstances set forth in the preceding paragraph, the People's Court shall, when rendering a judgment, clarify that the company shall promptly go through the statutory procedures for capital reduction or have other shareholders or a third party make the corresponding capital contributions. Before the statutory capital reduction procedures are completed or other shareholders or a third party make the corresponding capital contributions, if a creditor of the company requests the relevant parties to bear corresponding liability in accordance with Article 13 or Article 14 of these Provisions, the People's Court shall uphold such request.

Article 18 Where a shareholder of a limited liability company transfers its equity before performing or fully performing the capital contribution obligation, and the transferee knows or should have known of such fact, if the company requests the shareholder to perform the capital contribution obligation and the transferee to bear joint and several liability therefor, the People's Court shall uphold such request; if a creditor of the company files a lawsuit against the shareholder in accordance with the second paragraph of Article 13 of these Provisions and simultaneously requests the aforesaid transferee to bear joint and several liability therefor, the People's Court shall uphold such request.
Where the transferee, after assuming liability in accordance with the preceding paragraph, seeks recourse against the shareholder that failed to perform or fully perform the capital contribution obligation, the People's Court shall uphold such request, unless otherwise agreed by the parties.

Article 19 Where a company's shareholder fails to perform or fully perform the capital contribution obligation or withdraws its capital contribution, and the company or other shareholders request such shareholder to fully perform the capital contribution obligation or return the capital contribution to the company, if the defendant shareholder raises a defense based on the statute of limitations, the People's Court shall not uphold such defense.
Where the creditor's claim of the company is not yet time-barred, and the creditor requests, in accordance with the second paragraph of Article 13 or the second paragraph of Article 14 of these Provisions, a shareholder who fails to perform or fully perform the capital contribution obligation or withdraws its capital contribution to bear compensation liability, if the defendant shareholder raises a defense on the ground that the obligation to make capital contributions or return capital contributions has exceeded the statute of limitations, the People's Court shall not uphold such defense.

Article 20 Where a dispute arises between the parties as to whether a shareholder has performed the capital contribution obligation, if the plaintiff provides evidence that raises reasonable doubt about the shareholder's performance of the capital contribution obligation, the defendant shareholder shall bear the burden of adducing evidence that it has performed the capital contribution obligation.

Article 21 Where a party files a lawsuit with the People's Court requesting confirmation of its shareholder status, the company shall be named as the defendant, and any person with an interest in the equity under dispute in the case shall participate in the proceedings as a third party.

Article 23 Where a party, after performing the capital contribution obligation according to law or acquiring equity by succession according to law, the company fails to issue a capital contribution certificate, record the party in the register of shareholders, and register the matter with the company registration authority in accordance with Articles 31 and 32 of the Company Law, if the party requests the company to perform the above obligations, the People's Court shall uphold such request.

Article 24 Where an actual capital contributor and a nominal capital contributor of a limited liability company enter into a contract stipulating that the actual capital contributor shall make capital contributions and enjoy the investment returns, with the nominal capital contributor being the nominal shareholder, if a dispute arises between the actual capital contributor and the nominal shareholder regarding the validity of such contract, the People's Court shall find the contract valid unless there are statutory grounds for invalidity.
Where a dispute arises between the actual capital contributor and the nominal shareholder as specified in the preceding paragraph regarding the ownership of investment returns, and the actual capital contributor asserts its rights against the nominal shareholder on the ground that it has actually performed the capital contribution obligation, the People's Court shall uphold such claim. If the nominal shareholder denies the rights of the actual capital contributor on the ground of the records in the company's register of shareholders or the registration with the company registration authority, the People's Court shall not uphold such denial.
If the actual capital contributor, without the consent of more than half of the other shareholders of the company, requests the company to change the shareholder, issue a capital contribution certificate, record it in the register of shareholders, record it in the articles of association, and register it with the company registration authority, the People's Court shall not uphold such request.

Article 25 Where a nominal shareholder transfers, pledges, or otherwise disposes of the equity registered in its name, and the actual capital contributor, on the ground that it has actual rights to the equity, requests a finding that the disposal of the equity is invalid, the People's Court may handle the matter by reference to the provisions of Article 311 of the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China.
Where the disposal of the equity by the nominal shareholder causes loss to the actual capital contributor, and the actual capital contributor requests the nominal shareholder to bear compensation liability, the People's Court shall uphold such request.

Article 26 Where a creditor of the company requests a shareholder registered with the company registration authority to bear supplementary compensation liability to the extent of the unpaid capital and interest for the part of the company's debts that cannot be satisfied, on the ground that such shareholder has not performed the capital contribution obligation, and the shareholder defends on the ground that it is only a nominal shareholder and not the actual capital contributor, the People's Court shall not uphold such defense.
Where the nominal shareholder, after assuming compensation liability in accordance with the preceding paragraph, seeks recourse against the actual capital contributor, the People's Court shall uphold such request.

Article 27 Where, after the transfer of equity but before the change of registration with the company registration authority, the former shareholder transfers, pledges, or otherwise disposes of the equity still registered in its name, and the transferee shareholder, on the ground that it has actual rights to the equity, requests a finding that the disposal of the equity is invalid, the People's Court may handle the matter by reference to the provisions of Article 311 of the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China.
Where the disposal of the equity by the former shareholder causes loss to the transferee shareholder, and the transferee shareholder requests the former shareholder to bear compensation liability, and requests directors, senior officers, or actual controllers who are at fault for the failure to timely complete the change of registration to bear corresponding liability, the People's Court shall uphold such request; if the transferee shareholder is also at fault for the failure to timely complete the change of registration, the liability of the aforesaid directors, senior officers, or actual controllers may be appropriately reduced.

Article 28 Where a person uses another person's name to make capital contributions and registers such other person as a shareholder with the company registration authority, the person who made the false registration shall bear the corresponding liability; if the company, other shareholders, or creditors of the company request the person falsely registered as a shareholder to bear the liability to make up the capital contribution or bear compensation liability for the part of the company's debts that cannot be satisfied, on the ground that such person has not performed the capital contribution obligation, the People's Court shall not uphold such request.
